panels.title: Controllers online now
panels.description: v1 card 69. Whitelisted controllers in the newest snapshot (network_snapshot.controllers_in_region).

targets.rawSql: SELECT controllers_in_region AS "Controllers" FROM network_history ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Controllers online over time
panels.description: Screenshot-only chart (controllers online over time). Whitelisted controllers per snapshot, averaged into buckets that follow the dashboard range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(observed_at, $__interval),
       avg(controllers_in_region) AS "Controllers"
FROM network_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Controllers online now (list)
panels.description: Archived v1 card 67 ('Who's online?'), rebuilt from the controller sessions seen in the last two snapshots. Frequency shown in MHz.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign, name, cid, rank_group AS rating, frequency_mhz AS "Frequency (MHz)",
       logon_time AS "Logged on", hours_online AS "Hours online"
FROM controller_online_now
ORDER BY callsign

panels.title: Controllers logged on (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 115. Distinct controllers by rating group with more than 60 minutes online in total in the period. Observer and C2 ratings are left out, as in v1.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(sort, rank_group) AS (VALUES (2, 'S1'), (3, 'S2'), (4, 'S3'), (5, 'C1'), (7, 'C3'), (8, 'I1+')),
per_controller AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group, sum(duration_minutes) AS minutes
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY cid, rank_group
  HAVING sum(duration_minutes) > 60
)
SELECT r.rank_group, count(p.cid) AS controllers
FROM ranks r
LEFT JOIN per_controller p ON p.rank_group = r.rank_group
GROUP BY r.sort, r.rank_group
ORDER BY r.sort

panels.title: Controllers logged on (last 3 months)
panels.description: v1 card 116. As the 30-day chart, over 3 months.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranks(sort, rank_group) AS (VALUES (2, 'S1'), (3, 'S2'), (4, 'S3'), (5, 'C1'), (7, 'C3'), (8, 'I1+')),
per_controller AS (
  SELECT cid, rank_group, sum(duration_minutes) AS minutes
  FROM controller_session_ranked
  WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY cid, rank_group
  HAVING sum(duration_minutes) > 60
)
SELECT r.rank_group, count(p.cid) AS controllers
FROM ranks r
LEFT JOIN per_controller p ON p.rank_group = r.rank_group
GROUP BY r.sort, r.rank_group
ORDER BY r.sort

panels.title: CTR and FSS controllers active (rolling 30 days, weekly)
panels.description: v1 card 63. For each week, distinct controllers who started a CTR or FSS session of more than 60 minutes in the 30 days up to the end of that week. The v1 chart plotted weeks with zero as gaps; zeros are drawn here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT w.week_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT s.cid) AS "Controllers"
FROM generate_series(
       date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
       date_trunc('week', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
       interval '1 week') AS w(week_start)
LEFT JOIN controller_session_ranked s
       ON s.session_start >= (w.week_start + interval '1 week' - interval '30 days') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
      AND s.session_start <  (w.week_start + interval '1 week') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
      AND s.duration_minutes > 60
      AND s.is_ctr_fss
GROUP BY w.week_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Controllers active (rolling 30 days, weekly)
panels.description: v1 card 137. As the CTR/FSS chart, for all positions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT w.week_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       count(DISTINCT s.cid) AS "Controllers"
FROM generate_series(
       date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
       date_trunc('week', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
       interval '1 week') AS w(week_start)
LEFT JOIN controller_session_ranked s
       ON s.session_start >= (w.week_start + interval '1 week' - interval '30 days') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
      AND s.session_start <  (w.week_start + interval '1 week') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
      AND s.duration_minutes > 60
      
GROUP BY w.week_start
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 50 service providers (last 30 days)
panels.description: v1 card 108. Controllers ranked by hours online. Changed from v1: the score is hours online only (v1 added 5 points per hour to aircraft handled, which depended on frequency matching).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (array_agg(name ORDER BY session_start DESC))[1] AS controller,
       round((sum(duration_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Hours online"
FROM controller_session_ranked
WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND duration_minutes > 0
GROUP BY cid
ORDER BY sum(duration_minutes) DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Controllers with the shortest average session (last 30 days)
panels.description: UNVERIFIED. Screenshot-only chart ('Which controllers have the shortest avg session duration?'). The 15 controllers with the lowest average session length; the minimum of 3 sessions is an assumption because the v1 SQL was not recovered.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (array_agg(name ORDER BY session_start DESC))[1] AS controller,
       round(avg(duration_minutes)::numeric, 1) AS "Average session (minutes)"
FROM controller_session_ranked
WHERE session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY cid
HAVING count(*) >= 3
ORDER BY avg(duration_minutes), cid
LIMIT 15
